text: At the corner stood a drugstore. <break time="0.8s" /> That was bright with electric lights. <break time="0.8s" /> When they came into the glare. <break time="0.8s" /> Each man turned. <break time="0.8s" /> To look at the others face. <break time="0.8s" /> You are not Jimmy Wells. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the man from the West. <break time="0.8s" /> Stopping suddenly. <break time="0.8s" /> Twenty years is a long time. <break time="0.8s" /> But it is not long enough. <break time="0.8s" /> To change a mans nose. <break time="0.8s" /> From a Roman to a pug. <break time="0.8s" /> It sometimes changes. <break time="0.8s" /> A good man into a bad one. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the tall man. <break time="0.8s" /> You have been under arrest. <break time="0.8s" /> For ten minutes, Silky Bob. <break time="0.8s" /> The police in Chicago. <break time="0.8s" /> Want to talk with you. <break time="0.8s" /> You are going quietly. <break time="0.8s" /> Are you That is sensible. <break time="0.8s" /> Before we go to the station. <break time="0.8s" /> Here is a note. <break time="0.8s" /> That I was asked to give you. <break time="0.8s" /> It is from Patrolman Wells. <break time="0.8s" /> Bob opened the little note. <break time="0.8s" /> His hand was steady at first. <break time="0.8s" /> But it trembled a little. <break time="0.8s" /> By the end. <break time="0.8s" /> Bob, I was at the appointed place. <break time="0.8s" /> On time. <break time="0.8s" /> When you struck the match. <break time="0.8s" /> To light your cigar. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw the face of the man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was wanted in Chicago. <break time="0.8s" /> Somehow I could not do it myself. <break time="0.8s" /> So I went and got. <break time="0.8s" /> A plain clothes man. <break time="0.8s" /> To do the job Jimmy.
